name: markdown-preview-clean
title: Markdown Preview Clean
description: Preview Markdown in Raycast without the sidebar — full-width, distraction-free.
author: gilbert_yeh

commands.name: preview-markdown
commands.title: Preview Markdown
commands.description: Write and preview Markdown with a full-width, clean view

commands.name: preview-clipboard
commands.title: Preview Clipboard Markdown
commands.description: Preview Markdown currently in the clipboard

commands.name: history-list
commands.title: Markdown History
commands.description: Browse, search, and re-open previous Markdown previews

commands.name: preview-file
commands.title: Preview Markdown File
commands.description: Preview a .md from Finder selection, copied file, or path (relative images work in browser)

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "Use 'npm run publish' to publish this extension to the Raycast Store." && exit 1
